verdict: UNDERPOWERED, NOT NULL. Every one of the 4 discordant pair(s) went the same way, and with 4 the smallest two-sided p this test can produce is 0.1250. It cannot reach 0.05 however unanimous the evidence is, so p = 0.1250 here is a statement about the sample size and not about the prompt. The other two views do resolve it: the paired bootstrap [-0.533, -0.107] excludes zero, and the delta (-0.320) is 3.2x the A/A noise floor (0.100). Read the per-case table, then collect more cases before calling it significant. Do not report this as a null result.
